run_train_vlm_dpo: run DPO training on a vision-language model with multi-objective loss using a HuggingFace dataset
build_vlm_model_load: build a vision-language model from pretrained weights with optional 4/8-bit quantization and PEFT
create_dpo_trainer: create a DPO trainer with a model, datasets, and LoRA config for aligning vision-language models
test_dataset_load_rgb: test loading a dataset and converting images to RGB mode for vision-language training
summarize_mpo_loss_config: summarize multi-objective loss configuration with sigmoid, bco_pair, and sft loss types and weights
